title: paperless-ngx: refactor for easier overriding
structural_notes: Verified via direct diff of the fetched base-root/head-root module files that the ONLY change inside nixos/modules/services/misc/paperless.nix is one line (base line 624): PYTHONPATH's value changes from '${cfg.package.python.pkgs.makePythonPath cfg.package.propagatedBuildInputs}:...' to '${cfg.package.python.pkgs.makePythonPath cfg.package.passthru.dependencies}:...', tracking the package.nix refactor (rec {} -> finalAttrs: {}, frontend/dependencies moved under passthru, buildPythonApplication takes a finalAttrs function). Per the stated diff-touch rule, the only option watched is the baseline enable (services.paperless.enable, cfg_ident 'cfg', option_prefix [services, paperless]); no other option's declaration line was touched. nixos/tests/paperless.nix unchanged between base/head.
